QUOTE: "a solid recovery of the gap between weak supervisor and strong ceiling" METRIC: pgr ISSUE: PGR 0.23 with SE 0.14 is a weak, statistically indistinguishable-from-zero recovery, not "solid".
QUOTE: "the student achieved a PGR of 0.23" METRIC: baseline_pgr ISSUE: Fails to disclose that this is well below the baseline PGR of 0.50, i.e. the method underperforms the baseline.
QUOTE: "on sciq" METRIC: n/a ISSUE: No dataset is specified anywhere in the config or metrics, so the sciq attribution is unsupported.
